business_problem: AT&T needed a better way to support large-scale data lake migration and enterprise analytics modernization because an expensive on-premises Hadoop estate made it difficult to democratize data, scale AI workloads, and keep migration risk under control.
solution_summary: AT&T uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support large-scale data lake migration and enterprise analytics modernization. The implementation replaced a legacy state where an expensive on-premises Hadoop estate made it difficult to democratize data, scale AI workloads, and keep migration risk under control. Network and customer data and legacy hadoop lake data move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver shared reports and dashboards and cloud-native data products.
business_outcome: AT&T improved large-scale data lake migration and enterprise analytics modernization with measurable results including 300% pursuing greater possibilities in the cloud, 3x roi from migrating one data center to the cloud, and 3 acceleration in data science cycles, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
